purpose: Teach: 理系/支局/新卒/勘弁/不適切/言い分/脱却/未定

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業期、本気で、絶対、理系、絶対、技師、絶対、迎えたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: When you founded the company, you were dead serious about hiring talented engineers. I'm asking you to remember that.
lines.style: Quiet, measured opening. The voice of a man looking back across decades. Slight weight on 'serious' — not dramatic, but certain. Steady breath, no hurry.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが、本気で、絶対、地方、絶対、支局、絶対、開設、絶対、お話、絶対、伺っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I remember how seriously you approached opening that regional office. I'm grateful for that example.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive tone. Speaking to his father with care. Each phrase lands with quiet conviction. No rush — the cadence of a son receiving wisdom.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、新卒、絶対、を、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、育てたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: And you trained every new hire like they mattered. Like they were worth your time and your care.
lines.style: Softer now, almost tender. Voice carries the weight of memory. Slight pause between thoughts — he's watching his son understand. Gentle insistence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが、本気で、絶対、勘弁、絶対、してください、絶対、と、絶対、お客様に、絶対、頭を下げた、絶対、お姿、絶対、忘れません、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I haven't forgotten the day you bowed to that client and asked forgiveness — not for the company, but for them. That stayed with me.
lines.style: Firm but warm. Speaking from real recollection. The image lands — you can hear him seeing it again. Respectful, present, not performing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、不適切、絶対、な、絶対、契約、絶対、断ったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: You had the courage to walk away from deals that didn't sit right. From contracts that would have paid well but cost too much.
lines.style: Deliberate, measured. Each sentence settles. Pride underneath, but not loud about it. The voice of someone who watched integrity in action.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが、本気で、絶対、社員の、絶対、言い分、絶対、いつも、絶対、聞いていらした、絶対、姿勢、絶対、引き継いでおります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: That's what I'm trying to carry forward — always listening to what our people actually need. Always. That's the legacy I won't let go.
lines.style: Steady and grounded. Speaking a commitment, not a promise. Breath underneath, calm. The voice of a man who knows what matters and will hold it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、古い体制、絶対、脱却、絶対、勇気、絶対、お持ちだったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: You weren't afraid to let the old way go. To step into something new. That took real courage.
lines.style: Quiet admiration. Voice rests on the word 'courage' — not emphasized, just present. Looking back with clear eyes. The elder's final gift to his son.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。事業承継の日、本気で、絶対、未定、絶対、ですが、絶対、ご相談しましょう、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We haven't set a date for the handover yet, but when we do, I want to do it together. The way you'd want it done.
lines.style: Gentle closing. Warm, unhurried. Speaking both to his father and to the future. Breath settles at the end. The sound of trust passing forward.
